72	// NewScanner creates and returns a new scanner instance loaded with the specified data.
73	func NewScanner(data []byte) *Scanner {
74		return &Scanner{
75			data:         data,
76			lastRuneSize: -1,
77			maxFuncDepth: 3,

81	// Scanner represents a filter and lexical scanner.
82	type Scanner struct {
83		data         []byte
84		pos          int
85		maxFuncDepth int
86		lastRuneSize int // -1 means invalid
87	}

89	// Scan reads and returns the next available token value from the scanner's buffer.
90	func (s *Scanner) Scan() (Token, error) {
91		ch := s.read()
92	
93		if ch == eof {
94			return Token{Type: TokenEOF, Literal: ""}, nil
95		}
96	
97		if isWhitespaceRune(ch) {
98			s.unreadOnce()
99			return s.scanWhitespace()
100		}
101	
102		if isGroupStartRune(ch) {
103			s.unreadOnce()
104			return s.scanGroup()
105		}
106	
107		if isIdentifierStartRune(ch) {
108			s.unreadOnce()
109			return s.scanIdentifier(s.maxFuncDepth)
110		}
111	
112		if isNumberStartRune(ch) {
113			s.unreadOnce()
114			return s.scanNumber()
115		}
116	
117		if isTextStartRune(ch) {
118			s.unreadOnce()
119			return s.scanText(false)
120		}
121	
122		if isSignStartRune(ch) {
123			s.unreadOnce()
124			return s.scanSign()
125		}

127		if isJoinStartRune(ch) {
128			s.unreadOnce()
129			return s.scanJoin()
130		}

132		if isCommentStartRune(ch) {
133			s.unreadOnce()
134			return s.scanComment()
135		}

140	// scanWhitespace consumes all contiguous whitespace runes.
141	func (s *Scanner) scanWhitespace() (Token, error) {
142		var buf bytes.Buffer
143	
144		// Reads every subsequent whitespace character into the buffer.
145		// Non-whitespace runes and EOF will cause the loop to exit.
146		for {
147			ch := s.read()
148	
149			if ch == eof {
150				break
151			}
152	
153			if !isWhitespaceRune(ch) {
154				s.unreadOnce()
155				break
156			}
157	
158			// write the whitespace rune
159			buf.WriteRune(ch)
160		}
161	
162		return Token{Type: TokenWS, Literal: buf.String()}, nil
163	}

165	// scanNumber consumes all contiguous digit runes
166	// (complex numbers and scientific notations are not supported).
167	func (s *Scanner) scanNumber() (Token, error) {
168		var buf bytes.Buffer
169	
170		var hadDot bool
171	
172		// Read every subsequent digit rune into the buffer.
173		// Non-digit runes and EOF will cause the loop to exit.
174		for {
175			ch := s.read()
176	
177			if ch == eof {
178				break
179			}
180	
181			// not a digit rune
182			if !isDigitRune(ch) &&
183				// minus sign but not at the beginning
184				(ch != '-' || buf.Len() != 0) &&
185				// dot but there was already another dot
186				(ch != '.' || hadDot) {
187				s.unreadOnce()
188				break
189			}
190	
191			// write the rune
192			buf.WriteRune(ch)
193	
194			if ch == '.' {
195				hadDot = true
196			}
197		}
198	
199		total := buf.Len()
200		literal := buf.String()
201	
202		var err error
203		// only "-" or starts with "." or ends with "."
204		if (total == 1 && literal[0] == '-') || literal[0] == '.' || literal[total-1] == '.' {
205			err = fmt.Errorf("invalid number %q", literal)
206		}
207	
208		return Token{Type: TokenNumber, Literal: buf.String()}, err
209	}

211	// scanText consumes all contiguous quoted text runes.
212	func (s *Scanner) scanText(preserveQuotes bool) (Token, error) {
213		var buf bytes.Buffer
214	
215		// read the first rune to determine the quotes type
216		firstCh := s.read()
217	
218		if preserveQuotes {
219			buf.WriteRune(firstCh)
220		}
221	
222		var escapeNext bool
223		var hasMatchingQuotes bool
224	
225		// Read every subsequent text rune into the buffer.
226		// EOF and matching unescaped ending quote will cause the loop to exit.
227		for {
228			ch := s.read()
229	
230			if ch == eof {
231				break
232			}
233	
234			if escapeNext {
235				// reset escape state
236				escapeNext = false
237	
238				if !preserveQuotes {
239					switch ch {
240					case 'n':
241						buf.WriteRune('\n')
242					case 't':
243						buf.WriteRune('\t')
244					case 'r':
245						buf.WriteRune('\r')
246					case '\\', '\'', '"':
247						buf.WriteRune(ch)
248					default:
249						// escape regular literal
250						// (note: the backslash is added because we've skipped it in
251						// the escape start check to avoid back-and-forth mutation of the slice)
252						buf.WriteRune('\\')
253						buf.WriteRune(ch)
254					}
255				} else {
256					buf.WriteRune(ch)
257				}
258			} else if ch == '\\' {
259				// escape next char
260				escapeNext = true
261				if preserveQuotes {
262					buf.WriteRune(ch)
263				}
264			} else if ch == firstCh {
265				// unescaped matching quote, aka. the end
266				hasMatchingQuotes = true
267				if preserveQuotes {
268					buf.WriteRune(ch)
269				}
270	
271				break
272			} else {
273				buf.WriteRune(ch)
274			}
275		}
276	
277		literal := buf.String()
278	
279		var err error
280		if !hasMatchingQuotes {
281			// concatenated the initially skipped quote to allow easier debugging
282			if !preserveQuotes {
283				literal = string(firstCh) + literal
284			}
285	
286			err = fmt.Errorf("invalid quoted text %q", literal)
287		}
288	
289		return Token{Type: TokenText, Literal: literal}, err
290	}

292	// scanComment consumes all contiguous single line comment runes until
293	// a new character (\n) or EOF is reached.
294	func (s *Scanner) scanComment() (Token, error) {
295		var buf bytes.Buffer
296	
297		// Read the first 2 characters without writting them to the buffer.
298		if !isCommentStartRune(s.read()) || !isCommentStartRune(s.read()) {
299			return Token{Type: TokenComment}, ErrInvalidComment
300		}
301	
302		// Read every subsequent comment text rune into the buffer.
303		// \n and EOF will cause the loop to exit.
304		for i := 0; ; i++ {
305			ch := s.read()
306	
307			if ch == eof || ch == '\n' {
308				break
309			}
310	
311			buf.WriteRune(ch)
312		}
313	
314		return Token{Type: TokenComment, Literal: strings.TrimSpace(buf.String())}, nil
315	}

318	func (s *Scanner) scanIdentifier(funcDepth int) (Token, error) {
319		var buf bytes.Buffer
320	
321		// read the first rune in case it is a special start identifier character
322		buf.WriteRune(s.read())
323	
324		// Read every subsequent identifier rune into the buffer.
325		// Non-ident runes and EOF will cause the loop to exit.
326		for {
327			ch := s.read()
328	
329			if ch == eof {
330				break
331			}
332	
333			// func
334			if ch == '(' {
335				funcName := buf.String()
336				if funcDepth <= 0 {
337					return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName}, fmt.Errorf("max nested function arguments reached (max: %d)", s.maxFuncDepth)
338				}
339				if !isValidIdentifier(funcName) {
340					return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName}, fmt.Errorf("invalid function name %q", funcName)
341				}
342				s.unreadOnce()
343				return s.scanFunctionArgs(funcName, funcDepth)
344			}

346			// not an identifier character
347			if !isLetterRune(ch) && !isDigitRune(ch) && !isIdentifierCombineRune(ch) && ch != '_' {
348				s.unreadOnce()
349				break
350			}
351	
352			// write the identifier rune
353			buf.WriteRune(ch)
354		}
355	
356		literal := buf.String()
357	
358		var err error
359		if !isValidIdentifier(literal) {

361		}
362	
363		return Token{Type: TokenIdentifier, Literal: literal}, err

430	// scanGroup consumes all runes within a group/parenthesis.
431	func (s *Scanner) scanGroup() (Token, error) {
432		var buf bytes.Buffer
433	
434		// read the first group bracket without writing it to the buffer
435		firstChar := s.read()
436		openGroups := 1
437	
438		// Read every subsequent text rune into the buffer.
439		// EOF and parenthesis end will cause the loop to exit.
440		for {
441			ch := s.read()
442	
443			if ch == eof {
444				break
445			}
446	
447			if isGroupStartRune(ch) {
448				// nested group
449				openGroups++
450				buf.WriteRune(ch)
451			} else if isTextStartRune(ch) {
452				s.unreadOnce()
453				t, err := s.scanText(true) // with quotes to preserve the exact text start/end runes
454				if err != nil {
455					// write the errored literal as it is
456					buf.WriteString(t.Literal)
457					return Token{Type: TokenGroup, Literal: buf.String()}, err
458				}
459	
460				buf.WriteString(t.Literal)
461			} else if ch == ')' {
462				openGroups--
463	
464				if openGroups <= 0 {
465					// main group end
466					break
467				} else {
468					buf.WriteRune(ch)
469				}
470			} else {
471				buf.WriteRune(ch)
472			}
473		}
474	
475		literal := buf.String()
476	
477		var err error
478		if !isGroupStartRune(firstChar) || openGroups > 0 {
479			err = fmt.Errorf("invalid formatted group - missing %d closing bracket(s)", openGroups)
480		}
481	
482		return Token{Type: TokenGroup, Literal: literal}, err
483	}

485	// scanFunctionArgs consumes all contiguous function call runes to
486	// extract its arguments and returns a function token with the found
487	// Token arguments loaded in Token.Meta.
488	func (s *Scanner) scanFunctionArgs(funcName string, funcDepth int) (Token, error) {
489		var args []Token
490	
491		var expectComma, isComma, isClosed bool
492	
493		ch := s.read()
494		if ch != '(' {
495			return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName}, fmt.Errorf("invalid or incomplete function call %q", funcName)
496		}
497	
498		// Read every subsequent rune until ')' or EOF has been reached.
499		for {
500			ch := s.read()
501	
502			if ch == eof {
503				break
504			}
505	
506			if ch == ')' {
507				isClosed = true
508				break
509			}
510	
511			// skip whitespaces
512			if isWhitespaceRune(ch) {
513				_, err := s.scanWhitespace()
514				if err != nil {
515					return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName, Meta: args}, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan whitespaces in function %q: %w", funcName, err)
516				}
517				continue
518			}
519	
520			// skip comments
521			if isCommentStartRune(ch) {
522				s.unreadOnce()
523				_, err := s.scanComment()
524				if err != nil {
525					return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName, Meta: args}, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan comment in function %q: %w", funcName, err)
526				}
527				continue
528			}
529	
530			isComma = ch == ','
531	
532			if expectComma && !isComma {
533				return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName, Meta: args}, fmt.Errorf("expected comma after the last argument in function %q", funcName)
534			}
535	
536			if !expectComma && isComma {
537				return Token{Type: TokenFunction, Literal: funcName, Meta: args}, fmt.Errorf("unexpected comma in function %q", funcName)
538			}
539	
540			expectComma = false // reset
541	
542			if isComma {
543				continue
544			}
545	
546			if isIdentifierStartRune(ch) {
